The '''Uogo'cor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uogo'cor/Legends|Uogo'cor]] and several [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]].<ref name="GK" />
